resolved: “Prove that the event's exact submission start and end times are unchanged after cancellation.” — remember + expect_remembered compare a value across elements, screens or portals (as numbers with as/delta); expect_api_value compares with the API

resolved: “Prove that every vendor and bid on the event, rather than the prepared vendor and bid values, remains unchanged.” — remember + expect_remembered compare a value across elements, screens or portals (as numbers with as/delta); expect_api_value compares with the API

steps.note: Open the API-prepared live RFQ with one vendor bid.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Apply the required RFQ counter-offer configuration.
Apply the required bidding-time rejection configuration.
Apply the required buyer bid-editing configuration.
Apply the required percentage counter-offer configuration.
Reach the RFQ Responses tab where the buyer opens Settings.
Record the event's visible live state before opening the time dialog.
Verify the prepared vendor is present before cancellation.
Verify the prepared bid price before cancellation.
Open the Increase Event Time window from the RFQ Settings menu.
Cancel the time change without saving it.
Verify the event remains live after cancellation.
Verify the prepared vendor value is unchanged.
Verify the prepared bid price is unchanged.
